final:
swap_ends(var xs: List[int]) =
  ex swap_ends(&[1, 2, 3]) == [3, 2, 1]
  ex swap_ends(&[]) == []
  if xs.len() > 1
    let last = xs.len() - 1
    let tmp = xs[0]
    xs[0] = xs[last]
    xs[last] = tmp

test_swap_ends() =
  var xs = [1, 2, 3]
  swap_ends(&xs)
  assert xs == [3, 2, 1]

  var empty: List[int] = []
  swap_ends(&empty)
  assert empty == []

  var single = [42]
  swap_ends(&single)
  assert single == [42]

  var two = [10, 20]
  swap_ends(&two)
  assert two == [20, 10]
